dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for a housing loan and I wanted to check the status of my application. Could you please tell me if it has been approved, denied, or is still pending? Also, what is my interest rate and the total costs of the loan?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved. The interest rate is 6.875% and the total loan costs are $3,256.35.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. Could you also tell me if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan? Additionally, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA and it does not have any negative amortization features. Your loan has been sold to a credit union, mortgage company, or finance company.

dialogue.user: Got it. One last question: What type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: You were approved for a conventional first lien loan.

dialogue.user: Thank you very much for the information. <Satisfied> The agent was courteous, responsive, and provided clear and accurate information about my loan status, interest rate, total loan costs, and loan type. They also addressed my concerns about high-cost flags and loan transfer. I felt well-informed and satisfied with the interaction.
